name: UNSTUCK – Unified Platform Workflow (CV Processing, Scrapers, DB Sync & Analytics)

parameters.responseBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  success: true,
  message: 'CV processed successfully. Skills saved to Supabase profile and matched jobs radar dispatched.',
  user: $('Prepare Notification & Rank').first().json.user,
  skills: $('Prepare Notification & Rank').first().json.user?.skills || [],
  name: $('Prepare Notification & Rank').first().json.user?.name,
  professional_title: $('Prepare Notification & Rank').first().json.user?.title,
  experience_level: $('Prepare Notification & Rank').first().json.user?.experience_level,
  summary: $('Prepare Notification & Rank').first().json.user?.summary,
  matches_found: $('Prepare Notification & Rank').first().json.highScoreMatches,
  total_scraped_matches: $('Prepare Notification & Rank').first().json.totalMatches,
  top_jobs: $('Prepare Notification & Rank').first().json.jobs.slice(0, 5),
  email_notified: $('Prepare Notification & Rank').first().json.highScoreMatches > 0
}) }}
